name: Skysnag
summary: Skysnag turns DMARC reports into dashboards and auto-discovers sending sources. Its pricing page lists SPF record hosting and DKIM record management. Plans start at EUR 39 a month for Comply and EUR 249 a month for Protect, and authentication pricing depends on legitimate email volume.

facts.text: Its home page says the platform sends instant alerts for spoofing attempts, shadow IT senders and authentication failures, and that BrandGuard sends real-time alerts on suspicious domain registrations.
SPF record hosting, DKIM record management and an SPF optimization engine are listed on the pricing page. These are feature names only, with no descriptions.
Comply processes reports every 24 hours with 12 months of data. Protect processes them in real time with 5 years of data.
Non-profits may get up to 50% off Protect plans, and startups under 2 years old with under $5,000,000 in funding may get 20% off.
The trial is free for 14 days and does not require a credit card.

plans.name: Comply
plans.notes: Listed as From €39/month. Reports processed every 24 hours, 12 months of data

plans.name: Protect
plans.notes: Listed as From €249/month. Real-time processing, 5 years of data. Fully managed authentication with enforcement and monitoring

hiddenCosts: Authentication plan prices depend on the volume of legitimate email reported on the platform, so the starting figure may not match your bill.
The BIMI Digital Trademark service is billed annually and the VMC certificate is an add-on, with no price shown.
The feature table does not show which plan includes each feature, so confirm tier coverage with sales.
